Welcome to the observatory

Explore eight planets on approximate real-date orbits, or run an experimental interactive gravity sandbox.

  • Drag the sky to orbit your camera; mouse wheel zooms.
  • Click a planet (or select from the sidebar) to focus it.
  • Space pauses / resumes. H returns to overview.
  • Change appearance, orbit, and gravity variables in the right panel.
  • Readability mode enlarges planet sizes and compresses orbit distances. Physical mode uses one consistent distance-and-radius scale, so bodies may be almost invisible in overview; select a planet to inspect it.
  • Change the date or time speed from the bottom control strip.
  • SMASH MODE opens the cinematic weapons lab: target a planet surface to fire, adjust energy and radius, deploy shields, or restore damage. These effects are intentionally arcade physics, not realistic impact simulations.
